dialog.$description: Tokens for Dialog. Measured from the audit's captured CSS of AcmeCo's three dialogs (one csgp-modal system styled three ways: sign-in, contact broker, filters panel; audit family F31). Decision 28: the newest look (sign-in) for all three.

backdrop.$description: OBSERVED: black at 60% behind all three.

radius.$description: OBSERVED: 8px on the sign-in dialog (the newest), 4px on contact broker and filters; 8px for all (decision 28, amending decision 26).

shadow.$description: OBSERVED: 0 2px 15px at 15% black on the sign-in dialog, exactly shadow.raised (contact broker: a grey 8px glow; filters: a 1px #ddd border).

lg.$description: OBSERVED: sign-in, 768px (two 384px columns). The filters panel (852px) uses it too (decision 28).

viewport-margin.$description: PROPOSED: the least space kept around the dialog on a large screen, so it never touches the window edge.

padding.$description: OBSERVED: 24px around the sign-in header and body (contact broker: 25px).

gap.$description: PROPOSED: between the title and the Close button.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 22px (sign-in) and 19px (contact broker); became 20px, the heading-3 style.

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 400; became semibold, so dialog titles match the other headings.

background.$description: OBSERVED: the contact form's sticky white footer.

border-color.$description: OBSERVED: a 1px #c6c6c6 line above the contact form's footer; became the default border. Decorative: the footer is also set apart by position.

duration.$description: PROPOSED: fade in and out. Code only: Figma has no motion variables (decision 15).

color.$description: PROPOSED: the system focus ring, shown on the body when it scrolls and has keyboard focus.

width.$description: PROPOSED: 2px, drawn inside the body's edge.
